description: This file contains script functions related to system upgrade processes for specific hardware platforms, particularly involving device mounting, file copying, and upgrade logic for embedded systems based on various hardware configurations.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs upgrade of system on sdcard boot, including writing kernel and root filesystem

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles system upgrade for specific UBI partition setup

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies configuration backups to the sdcard device

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies system configuration based on hardware model

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image is supported on the current hardware platform

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher based on hardware platform
